name: lifecycle-registry-v1
title: Lifecycle Registry V1: single-source-of-truth for phase commands and artifacts
description: Lifecycle governance step 1. lifecycle-registry.ts (B-d339) is already a lifecycle fact registry — LIFECYCLE_TRANSITIONS carries gates/effects/oracleRows/rendererRow per transition, and phase-flow.ts/context.ts derive the phase graph from it. Two dimensions are still missing: phase-to-commands (which koala commands are legal per phase) and phase/transition-to-artifacts (which artifact files each phase produces/consumes). Today those facts live independently in command-policy.ts allowedPhases, config.ts DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS, and the process-fact registry, with no mechanical proof they stay consistent. This story upgrades the registry to V1 single-source-of-truth: add the commands and artifacts dimensions, and add a consistency contract test so command-policy, DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS, and process-fact lifecycle are all validated against the one registry. Explicitly out of scope: no public behavior change, no TEST semantics change, no legacy main-type change, no story_advance restructure (those are Story 2/3/4).
